revenueProvenance.basis: Issuer consolidated revenue and reported gross profit. FY2019/FY2020 continuing revenue excludes discontinued operations; attributable net income remains total owners' income.
revenueProvenance.operatingIncomeBasis: When no operating subtotal is printed, sum all statement lines above finance costs excluding equity-accounted results (equivalently PBT plus finance costs less share of associate profit). Includes reported fair-value, disposal and impairment gains/losses, not recurring earnings. Older H1 statements explicitly report profit/loss from operations.
revenueProvenance.businessScope: Gaming-related investment/operations historically including Cambodia tables and AR/VR. FY2026 primary report describes transformation to Philippine online entertainment and cessation of physical Cambodia table operations in April 2025; not a Macau concession.

annual.notes: Attributable profit 12427 differs from group profit 8564 due to NCI loss 3863. Operating result includes receivable-impairment reversal 28370; not recurring cash earnings.

limitations: 0959-consolidated-net-gaming-service-fees-gross-trading links FY2025/FY2026 and September 2024/2025 H1, supporting FY-minus-H1 and the September 2025 TTM. Annual note 7 and interim note 5 use the same revenue categories: net Cambodia gaming win, AR/VR services, online-platform sub-licensing service fees and gross camellia-oil sales. The latest actual revenue is service fees 23680 plus trading 6578, NOT gross underlying online wagers/GGR; H1 is fees 5068 plus trading 692. Zero comparative turnover does not erase real FY2025 gross losses.

Older Vanuatu/discontinued, AR/VR and pre-standard presentations are not automatically joined to this current basis. No issuer-level 'principal gaming' label authorizes grossing up service fees into player wagers or treating the current group as a Macau concession.
All eight provider annual periods and all sixteen provider H1 dates are supported; FY2026 is additionally available officially despite absent provider annual capture.
No current quote, market cap, suspension determination or current trading status is certified here. Provider quote timestamp 2025-06-25 is not a current valuation observation.
FY2019/FY2020 D&A uses continuing-only note components 835+5866 and 594+10642+4820 respectively. Do not substitute the larger group cash-flow amounts containing discontinued activities.
Reported zero turnover/COGS/GP in dormant years must remain zero, not null or prior-year revenue. FY2025 has zero turnover but 9176 cost of services and a real gross loss.
Reported operating subtotals in early interims override the record's general derived convention. Early enormous associate profits are not consolidated revenue or operating income.
